text:
kai: Tiny poll while we92re deciding lunch  which LLM name would make the best cocktail name? React with emoji to vote:

:neon: for "Redwood Riptide" (aka a strong classic), :leaf: for "Pineapple Pine" (tropical), :ember: for "Quantized Quencher" (experimental), :star: for "Latency Limoncello" (zesty)

opsbot: Poll created by kai.

reena: :neon: for Redwood Riptide  sounds fancy and marketable :sunglasses:

mike: :ember: Quantized Quencher  would drink that while benchmarking

anya: :leaf: Pineapple Pine  100% would order with an umbrella

kai: also quick one  editor preference? react :vscode: for VS Code, :neovim: for Neovim, :intellij: for IntelliJ, :emacs: for Emacs

reena: :vscode:

mike: :neovim: but lowkey use VS Code sometimes

anya: :emacs: for life

opsbot: Current tallies: Redwood Riptide 1, Pineapple Pine 1, Quantized Quencher 1; VS Code 2, Neovim 1, Emacs 1

kai: okay looks tied on the cocktail vote  tie-breaker: fastest one-word pitch for your pick

reena: Redwood Riptide  "clean"

mike: Quantized Quencher "experimental"

anya: Pineapple Pine "sunny"

kai: winner by charm: Pineapple Pine! Also VS Code wins editor poll. Lunch plan: ordering from the food truck outside 

reena: hooray food truck :tada:

opsbot: Poll closed.
